evidence: shuffling the target side of training edges drops the real score from **0.4389 / 0.4955** to **0.2802 / 0.2525**
observation: On the subset where every negative has exactly the positive disease's training degree, the SVD stays far above the degree prior, which is at chance. A degree-preserving permutation of the training target side collapses the ensemble to near base/degree, so the gain is association pattern rather than topology or residual degree.
subject: F-51
title: Exact-degree subset and target permutation confirm the SVD is not degree
